title: Classic Age
description: The classic textures of Minecraft Java Edition
body:
# ENGLISH
This texture pack changes all the textures in Minecraft Java Edition to their classic and improved textures from the Classic Age pack. The textures range from versions 1.0 to 1.13, combining some textures from between those versions:

1. New textures for blocks that didn't exist in those versions! ![NEW TEXTURES](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac2e4103ae41bfb8684c2c5b8ea400e381e3a6ab.png)

2. New textures for items! ![NEW ITEMS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f023106ef138e9f51d291ac24e9f0d75ad75154b.png)
XD (Itemss)

3. New Netherite set and the Classic Zombie Pigman! ![NEW NETHERITE ARMOR AND OLD ZOMBIE PIGMAN](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5982daf049181de14f07334329479e2715e6409.png)

## REQUIRED MODS

### FOR 1.16

FORGE:
- Optifine for 1.16

Fabric:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] for 1.16
- CEM for 1.16, but you have to extract the CEM folder from the Optifine folder

### FOR 1.17

FORGE:
- Optifine for 1.17

FABRIC:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] for 1.17
- CEM for 1.17, but you have to extract the CEM folder from the Fabrica folder Optifine

### FOR 1.18

FORGE:
- Optifine for 1.18

FABRIC:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] for 1.18
- Entity Model Feature [EMF] for 1.16
# ESPAÑOL

Este texture pack cambia todas las texturas de Minecraft Java Edition a sus texturas clasicas y mejoradas con el pack de Classic Age, las texturas son entre la 1.0 y la 1.13 combinando algunas texturas entre esas versiones:

1.Nuevas texturas a bloques que no existian en esas versiones![Nuevas texturas de los bloques](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/400267ae287bd5b51c64b8a36caaf54af11f97fc.png)


2.Nuevas texturas de los items![Nuevas texturas de los items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f023106ef138e9f51d291ac24e9f0d75ad75154b.png)

XD (Itemss)

3.Nuevo set de netherite y el clasico Zombie Pigman![Armadura de netherite y zombie pigman](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5982daf049181de14f07334329479e2715e6409.png)


## MODS NECESARIOS

### PARA LA 1.16

FORGE:
- Optifine para la 1.16

Fabric:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] para la 1.16
- CEM para la 1.16, pero tienen que sacar la carpeta CEM de la carpeta optifine

### PARA LA 1.17

FORGE:
- Optifine para la 1.17

FABRIC:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] para la 1.17
- CEM para la 1.17, pero tienen que sacar la carpeta CEM de la carpeta optifine

### PARA LA 1.18

FORGE:
- Optifine para la 1.18

FABRIC:
- Entity Texture Feature [ETF] para la 1.18
- Entity Model Feature [EMF] para la 1.16

### NOTA:
Este texture pack esta solo en ingles, si alguien quiere traducir lo que he hecho en ingles en español (es poco) les doy creditos
